metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Kyiv decrease in March 2022 compared to January 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nighttime light intensity changes in Kyiv between January 2022 and March 2022. This is during the period when Russia invaded Ukraine (February 24, 2022), so we would expect a significant decrease in nighttime lights in March 2022. For nighttime light data, I should use: - VIIRS Day/Night Band (VNP46A2) for 2022 data - Focus on the 'DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m' band or similar nighttime light bands - Kyiv geometry (I'll create a polygon around Kyiv) - January 2022 (before invasion) vs March 2022 (after invasion started) I need to: 1. Define Kyiv geometry 2. Get VIIRS nighttime light data for both periods 3. Calculate mean radiance for each period 4. Compare the values to see if March 2022 shows decrease 5. Handle potential data quality issues For cloud masking: VIIRS nighttime data doesn't have traditional cloud masking like optical data, but I should check for quality flags if available. Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const kyiv = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [30.2, 50.6], [30.8, 50.6], [30.8, 50.3], [30.2, 50.3], [30.2, 50.6] ]); const jan2022 = ['2022-01-01', '2022-01-31']; const mar2022 = ['2022-03-01', '2022-03-31']; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Nighttime Lights const viirsJan = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(jan2022[0], jan2022[1]) .filterBounds(kyiv); const viirsMar = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate(mar2022[0], mar2022[1]) .filterBounds(kyiv); // Check collection sizes const janSize = viirsJan.size().getInfo(); const marSize = viirsMar.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2022 Images: ${janSize}`); console.log(`March 2022 Images: ${marSize}`); if (janSize === 0 || marSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get mean composites const janMean = viirsJan.mean(); const marMean = viirsMar.mean(); // 3. Processing - Calculate mean radiance const janRadiance = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: kyiv, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const marRadiance = marMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: kyiv, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const janCount = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: kyiv, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const marCount = marMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: kyiv, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`January Radiance: ${janRadiance?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${janCount}`); console.log(`March Radiance: ${marRadiance?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${marCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (janRadiance === null || marRadiance === null || isNaN(janRadiance) || isNaN(marRadiance) || janCount === 0 || marCount === 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if March radiance is less than January radiance if (marRadiance < janRadiance) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
